description: This file provides a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with an Agent class, enabling users to list available functions, call functions with arguments, get help on specific functions, and launch an interactive shell. It uses argparse for command parsing, supports async functions, loads function signatures, and handles metadata retrieval for agent reasoners and skills.

classes.name: AgentCLI
classes.description: A class that handles command-line interactions for an Agent instance, including listing functions, executing functions with parsed CLI args, displaying help, and launching an interactive shell.

methods.name: __init__(self, agent_instance)
methods.description: Initializes the CLI handler with an instance of the Agent.

methods.name: List[str] _get_all_functions(self)
methods.description: Retrieves a sorted list of all available reasoners and skills from the agent.

methods.name: Optional[Callable] _get_function(self, func_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific function from the agent by name, unwrapping any wrapper to get the original function.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _get_function_metadata(self, func_name: str)
methods.description: Provides metadata (type, id, description) for a given function name, checking among reasoners and skills.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_function_args( self, func: Callable, cli_args: List[str] )
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments according to a function's signature and type hints, converting JSON strings for lists and dicts where applicable.

methods.name: None _call_function(self, func_name: str, cli_args: List[str])
methods.description: Executes a function with parsed arguments from CLI, handling async functions and exceptions.

methods.name: None _show_function_help(self, func_name: str)
methods.description: Displays help information for a specified function, including signature, docstring, and usage example.

methods.name: None _list_functions(self)
methods.description: Lists all available reasoners and skills with their signatures and first line of descriptions.

methods.name: None _interactive_shell(self)
methods.description: Launches an IPython interactive shell with context populated by agent's functions.

methods.name: None run_cli(self)
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI, orchestrates command parsing and dispatch.

ctags.name: _call_function
ctags.pattern: /^    def _call_function(self, func_name: str, cli_args: List[str]) -> None:$/
